description: This Java class 'SecretsAsConfigSupplier' reads secret configurations from files located in a directory specified by an environment variable or default path. It supplies a consolidated Config object containing these secrets, integrating with the typesafe Config library.

classes.name: SecretsAsConfigSupplier
classes.description: A final, immutable class implementing Supplier<Config> that reads secrets from filesystem paths configured via environment variables or defaults and provides a combined Config object containing these secrets.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance with the initial configuration context.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a Config object with secrets attached under the 'secrets' key.

methods.name: getSecretsDirPath
methods.description: Returns the Path of the secrets directory being used.
